newsitem.title: USA: Poore Bros says judge drops lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Poore Bros says judge drops lawsuit.

text.p: Poore Brothers Inc. Wednesday said a judge dismissed a lawsuit which had been pending against certain of its directors and Poore Brothers Southeast Inc. in the Maricopa County, Arizona Superior Court.
Poore Brothers President and Chief Executive Eric Kufel, said summary judgment had been granted in favor of the defendants on all counts of the complaint.

"The Company is extremely pleased with this result, since it confirms our position that the suit was totally without merit," hje said. "With the termination of the lawsuit, we now look forward to focusing management's efforts on development of the Company's business."
